Renamed user-visible branding from **Sissy Training** to **Dickalicious Training**. Subtitle **Discipline & progress** is unchanged.

### Files changed
| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/components/Layout.tsx` | App title in header |
| `src/pages/Login.tsx` | Login page title |
| `index.html` | `<title>` and `apple-mobile-web-app-title` |
| `vite.config.ts` | PWA `name`, `short_name` (`Dickalicious`), `description` |
| `README.md` | Title and install instructions |
| `public/pwa-512x512.svg` | Icon label text (font size 32 for longer name) |
| `public/pwa-192x192.svg` | Abbreviation `ST` → `DT` |

### Left unchanged (backward compatibility)
- `src/lib/storage.ts` — `sissy-training-state`
- `src/lib/auth.ts` — `sissy-training-auth`
- `README.md` line documenting the storage key name
- `package.json` / lockfile package name (`sissy-training`)

No remaining user-visible **Sissy** strings in `src/` or `public/` outside those storage keys.
